_comment: District-level soil nutrients that no remote source provides. SoilGrids models pH, N, CEC, SOC and texture but NOT phosphorus or potassium, so these come from published Indian soil-survey data and are labelled 'seeded' in every profile that uses them. They are DISTRICT AVERAGES, not measurements of any one field.

ratingClasses._comment: Standard Indian soil-test rating boundaries, kg/ha.

districts.note: Narwana tehsil, the Build Brief demo location, sits in Jind district on the Kaithal border.

units.k: kg/ha available K (as K2O, ammonium-acetate extractable)

derivation.p: Jind district mean phosphate reported as 15.73 kg/acre = 38.9 kg/ha P2O5; x0.436 = 17.0 kg/ha elemental P. Independently corroborated: a separate survey rates Jind 'medium' available phosphorus, and 17.0 falls inside the medium band (10-25).
derivation.k: Jind rated 'high' available potash district-wide (high = >280 kg/ha). 300 is a representative value just inside that band; neighbouring Kaithal block surveys span 80-440 kg/ha.

districts.replaceWith: An actual Soil Health Card reading for the demo field, if product can obtain one.
